drivers.statement: CNBC and Investopedia described a broad Friday rebound as oil retreated from its earlier weekly surge and investors absorbed the August CPI release.
BLS reported August all-items CPI +0.4% month-on-month and +3.4% year-on-year; core CPI +0.3% month-on-month and +2.4% year-on-year.
The 15–16 September FOMC meeting and 16 September statement/press conference remain future events at this report cutoff.

companies.evidence: Official Q1 FY27 revenue $19.345bn (+30%), cloud revenue $11.607bn (+62%), IaaS revenue $7.4bn (+121%) and RPO $664bn; Q1 free cash flow was -$5bn.

Reuters reported that Anthropic was in talks for NVIDIA to be an anchor investor in a possible IPO and cited a source saying NVIDIA was considering up to $10bn. The discussions could change; neither company confirmed to Reuters.

Reuters, citing Bloomberg reporting, said Altman told staff OpenAI could pace development alongside other labs; an Anthropic spokesperson said it was interested in industry work on the pace of releases.
